# Omarchy Privacy Devices

Omarchy Privacy Devices is an Omarchy plugin for inspecting and controlling supported camera, microphone, and privacy-device state. The site covers installation, controls, status, and safety behavior.

## Documentation

- Overview: https://bolens.github.io/omarchy-privacy-devices/
- Changelog: https://bolens.github.io/omarchy-privacy-devices/changelog/

## Source

- Repository: https://github.com/bolens/omarchy-privacy-devices
- Issues: https://github.com/bolens/omarchy-privacy-devices/issues
